caption.text: La Fortuna, Costa Rica is gorgeous at night 🌕🇨🇷🌃 #joefelz #costarica #citylights #expatlife

Cat eyed snake or Caribbean tree boa? I nabbed a snake working with José today & couldn’t identify it despite all redneckery, so we checked the book. 

Kobi thought it was a Caribbean tree boa, which is native to Costa Rica, but I thought it was a cat eyed snake, which does not live here according to the book. 

Kind of crazy because when I was 13, I caught a horned lizard in the dunes of Edisto, Island and the SRS ecology lab extended the range of the species all the way to coastal Carolina. Who knows, I might’ve just done it again 🇨🇷🐍🤷‍♂️ #joefelz #herpetology #snakes #wildlife #reptiles

Wanna DIY your own solar but don’t know where to start?

After spending MONTHS of my life designing solar systems for people I finally built a tool so you can do it yourself.

You can use FelzCalc here for the low price of free fiddy, McCletus: https://youtu.be/994EhMJ6BMc

Just posted a video explaining how it works so hopefully all of you can find your free, just like me.

Sending love, peace & chicken grease from the jungle 🇨🇷☀️🆓 #joefelz #solar #offgrid #diy #renewableenergy

Rarely am I stumped but this langostino got me: after catching dinner I cleaned them up & found 2 white pearl like stones in one of them. 

They are hard as rock, smooth & shaped like a half moon with a circular impression on one side. I’ve showed every Tico here & even they don’t know.

Seems like a total anamoly to me & maybe even a good omen? Someone tell me what I found cause I wanna make a necklace of out them but also don’t wanna unknowingly place a lobster curse on me 🇨🇷🦞🤷‍♂️ #joefelz #biology #costarica #questions #langostino
